description.value: A lodge campground at Tete Jaune Cache on Highway 16, conveniently positioned between Jasper and Prince George with showers, potable water, and device charging — a practical resupply and rest stop at a key route junction.

Phone number 1-250-566-9815 and email appear on the website but are absent from OSM tags, so contact_confirmed.phone is null.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible campground with an active website, confirmed onsite amenities, and reservation capability — a solid stop for touring cyclists on the Robson Valley corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website lists 'Bicycles' as an onsite amenity, which may indicate bicycle rentals are available to guests. OSM power_supply=yes likely refers to RV electrical hookups (caravans=yes) rather than general device charging — not confirmed as cyclist device charging.
